actualValue.effect: For each NewConditionsBuffer item invoke EntityUtility.AddOrRefreshCondition with condition data, current tick/rate, condition table, and summarized conditions; afterwards clear NewConditionsBuffer. A processed queue item does not guarantee a changed ConditionsBuffer.

For same-ID entries ShouldOverrideCondition selects whether to replace based on remaining value comparison when configured or current duration <= new duration otherwise. A rejected match does not become a fresh addition. On accepted replacement, additive values may be combined and capped; nonadditive values may be adjusted by stacks; existing element is replaced with a calculated removeTick. If no matching ID exists, append a new ConditionsBuffer element with calculated removeTick.

Separately, SummarizeConditionsSystem checks chunk change versions/order and clears then recomputes summary buffers. Ordinary own conditions of a buff-owner pet are skipped except PetBuffsIncrease; valid table IDs accumulate by condition ID and mapped effect. Other contribution sources also exist. Scheduling, dependency and timing determine when a new summary is visible; no same-tick claim.

The later condition removal job considers nonpermanent finite positive durations and elapsed removeTick, marked removals, and active-effect removal. Certain stack conditions can refresh instead; it queues removal indices and RemoveConditionsJob removes them. Entity/query state, ticking, special condition branches and other removal paths apply.

actualValue.effect: For each NewConditionsBuffer item invoke EntityUtility.AddOrRefreshCondition with condition data, current tick/rate, condition table, and summarized conditions; afterwards clear NewConditionsBuffer. A processed queue item does not guarantee a changed ConditionsBuffer.

For same-ID entries ShouldOverrideCondition selects whether to replace based on remaining value comparison when configured or current duration <= new duration otherwise. A rejected match does not become a fresh addition. On accepted replacement, additive values may be combined and capped; nonadditive values may be adjusted by stacks; existing element is replaced with a calculated removeTick. If no matching ID exists, append a new ConditionsBuffer element with calculated removeTick.

Separately, SummarizeConditionsSystem checks chunk change versions/order and clears then recomputes summary buffers. Ordinary own conditions of a buff-owner pet are skipped except PetBuffsIncrease; valid table IDs accumulate by condition ID and mapped effect. Other contribution sources also exist. Scheduling, dependency and timing determine when a new summary is visible; no same-tick claim.

The later condition removal job considers nonpermanent finite positive durations and elapsed removeTick, marked removals, and active-effect removal. Certain stack conditions can refresh instead; it queues removal indices and RemoveConditionsJob removes them. Entity/query state, ticking, special condition branches and other removal paths apply.
